title: One outlier moves the least-squares line
caption: For (1, 1) to (4, 4) and (5, 20), least squares gives slope 4 and passes through the mean point (3, 6); the Theil–Sen slope, the median of pairwise slopes, is 1 and ignores the outlier.
alt: Graph with a steep line y = 4x − 6 (least squares) pulled up by the outlier at (5, 20) and the line y = x (Theil–Sen) through the other four points.
description: The Theil–Sen slope is the median of the pairwise slopes, which is 1.
The point (5, 20) drags the first line up but hardly moves the second.
